checks.dec114_def3: isLeast_pi_locallyConvexTopology n : IsLeast {t | IsTopologicalAddGroup[t] ∧ ContinuousSMul ℝ[t] ∧ LocallyConvexSpace ℝ[t]} Pi.topologicalSpace. Checked in a scratch file that the three conditions are about `t` (the `_` slots cannot absorb it) and that Mathlib's order is t₁ ≤ t₂ ⟺ every t₂-open set is t₁-open (TopologicalSpace.le_def), so IsLeast = FINEST, as the docstring says. Membership of Pi is by inferInstance (non-vacuous); minimality is pi_le_of_isTopologicalAddGroup, which is stronger (finest vector-space topology). S.topology_eq is `rfl` (the instance of S n unfolds to the quotient of the Pi topology); it is a restatement whose content is carried by isLeast_pi_locallyConvexTopology, as its docstring says. The infinite-dimensional default is not constructed and SCOPE says so; DEC-114 certifies the row on ℝⁿ
checks.dec114_projective: ProjSpace is a def (not reducible) synonym, so no orphan topology lands on ℙ ℝ E. coinduced_toProjectivization: coinduced toProjectivization (coinduced s sub) = coinduced (toProjectivization ∘ s) sub = coinduced p sub, via coinduced_compose and toProjectivization_comp_s (rfl): this is exactly « P(E) muni de la topologie quotient » and its agreement with the quotient of S(E) by the antipodal map (toProjectivization_eq_iff). Correct, and the docstring matches

fidelity_summary: Déf. 3 is formalized faithfully for any topology on E: S(E) and P(E) are the quotients of E − {O} by ℝ⁺ and ℝ*, both with their quotient topologies, s and F as printed, and the two topologies of P(E) agree.
